data.narrative:
True Anomaly is a Series D defense and security company founded by Even Rogers, Kyle Zakrzewski, Daniel Brunski, and Tom Nichols, currently valued at $2.2B post-money following $1B+ in total capital raised. The valuation assessment benchmarks against a comp universe of 10 private and 2 public peers operating in the same sector and stage.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis assumes a typical Series D-to-next-stage step-up multiplier of 1.5x applied to the $2.2B last post-money valuation, implying $3.3B. Peer-median benchmarking draws from four same-sector, same-stage comparables—Saronic ($9.2B), Quantum-Systems ($8.0B), Chaos Industries ($4.5B), and Onebrief ($2.1B)—yielding a median of $6.2B with a range spanning $2.1B to $9.2B. The broader comparable set includes Anduril Industries among top private peers, alongside public references DRSHF and IDEAFORGE.NS.

The two-method triangulation supports a valuation range of $2.8B to $7.2B, with a median implied value of $4.8B. The current $2.2B valuation sits at the lower bound of this range, reflecting either discount relative to peer medians or suggests True Anomaly carries material execution or revenue-scaling uncertainty relative to its peer cohort. Key uncertainties include revenue traction relative to funded peer companies and the applicability of peer multiples given potential differentiation in defensibility or TAM capture.
